Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience, the following contract(s) will be admitted to trading on Binance RIE and admitted to Clearing and Settlement by Binance RCH at the time specified below: 2026-07-17 03:00 (UTC): MINIMAXUSDT USDT-Priced Perpetual Contract  2026-07-17 03:05 (UTC): ZHIPUUSDT USDT-Priced Perpetual Contract  2026-07-22 03:00 (UTC): HK0700USDT Quanto Perpetual Contract  2026-07-22 03:05 (UTC): HK1810USDT Quanto Perpetual Contract  2026-07-22 03:10 (UTC): TENCENTUSDT USDT-Priced Perpetual Contract  What Is a Binance Futures Quanto Perpetual Contract: Binance Futures Quanto Perpetual Contract allows users to trade non-USD-denominated equity in local currency without any foreign exchange conversion. The perpetual contract is priced in the local currency, such as HKD and JPY,  while the settlement and payoff are settled in USDT. It removes cross-currency exchange rate fluctuation risk. Difference between a USDT-Priced Contract and a Quanto Contract: The Price Index of a USDT-Priced Contract is obtained based on the price of the underlying asset on the exchange on which it is primarily traded (in this case, the price of the relevant Hong Kong stock on the HKEX), with a HKD/USD FX rate applied. The FX rate is provided by a third party vendor and updated on a real time basis.  A quanto contract is a futures contract in which the underlying asset is priced in one quote asset, but the margin and P&L are settled in another quote asset. In this case, the price of the relevant Hong Kong stock on the HKEX is treated as if denominated in USDT on a one-to-one basis for the purposes of margining and settlement, without any foreign exchange conversion. Example: User A has a long position in HK0700USDT Quanto Perpetual Contract with a contract size of 10 HK0700 and an average entry price of 450. The user closes the position when the price of HK0700USDT Quanto Perpetual Contract is at 500. 1. Trading Fee Assume the trading fee is 0.04%  Trading Fee= Notional Position * Trading Fee  = 450 * 10 * 0.04% = 1.8  The fee payable when the user opens a position is 1.8 USDT. 2. Funding Fee Assume the funding rate is 0.01% Funding Fee = Notional Position * Funding Rate = 450 * 10 * 0.01% = 0.45  The funding fee the user would need to pay is 0.45 USDT.  3. Maintenance Margin Assume the maintenance margin rate is 1% Maintenance Margin = Notional Position * Maintenance Margin Rate = 450 * 10 * 1% = 45 4. Realised PNL  = (Closing Price - Average Entry Price) * Contract Size  = (500 - 450) * 10  = 500   500 USDT will be credited to the user’s Futures Account after they closed the position. 关于Bitget Quanto永续合约：
Bitget Quanto永续合约让用户可以直接用 USDT 交易港股、日股等非美元计价的海外股票，全程无需兑换外币。合约本身以港元或日元等当地货币报价，但保证金的存入、盈亏的结算全部以 USDT 完成，彻底规避了汇率波动带来的额外风险。
 
Quanto 合约是什么？
简单来说：标的资产用一种货币定价，但保证金和盈亏用另一种货币来结算。以本次 MINIMAX 合约为例，港股 MINIMAX 的价格以港元报价，但在计算保证金和盈亏时，系统将其视为等额 USDT（按 1:1 换算），不涉及任何外汇兑换操作。
 
举例说明（以 MINIMAX Quanto 永续合约为例）
合约的数字波动与正股完全一致，但结算单位是 USDT 而不是港元。
用户 A 以均价 200 买入 10 MINIMAXHKD 多单，价格涨到 300 后平仓。
 
1. 交易手续费（费率 0.04%）

手续费 = 名义仓位价值 × 费率 = 200× 10 × 0.04% = 0.8 USDT 开仓时需支付 0.8 USDT 手续费。

2. 资金费（费率 0.01%）

资金费 = 名义仓位价值 × 费率 = 200 × 10 × 0.01% = 0.2 USDT 每期需支付 0.2 USDT 资金费。

3. 维持保证金（保证金率 1%）

维持保证金 = 名义仓位价值 × 保证金率 = 200 × 10 × 1% = 20 USDT 持仓期间账户须保持至少 20 USDT 的维持保证金，否则触发强平。

4. 已实现盈亏

盈亏 = (平仓价 - 开仓价) × 合约数量 = (300 - 200) × 10 = 1000 USDT 平仓后，1000 USDT 直接结算至合约账户。
